title: med2s/0.1
description: Records of med2s (Matherly; Stata package 4.1.1, 2026-09-22): natural direct and indirect effects in staggered-adoption difference-in-differences, on the two-stage DiD first stage (Gardner 2021; see spec/profiles/med2s.md). Includes mediation/0.1, plus: meta.estimator.method "med2s"; specification.did as in did/0.1 (unit, time, treatment, comparison "untreated", anticipation); specification.clusters (the assignment level); specification.options adjust, adjgap, adjk, version, sigcrit; inference by cluster bootstrap with percentile intervals (med2s_ci); a `med2s` object on each med2s quantity row naming the quantity and its adjustment; and an extensions.med2s block (this file defines it) with the signal test and flag, the treated and placebo moments, the placebo rows and their composition, and, when run, the med2s_diag diagnostics and the med2s_sens breakdown analysis. A bare med2s run (no med2s_ci) has no inference for the adjusted quantities and does not meet mediation/0.1.

clusters.description: cluster(): the level at which treatment is assigned.

mediators.description: med2s estimates one mediator per run; med2s_report combines runs.

absorb.description: First-stage fixed effects, unit first, time second.

adjgap.description: Periods between the placebo window and adoption.

sigcrit.description: One-sided cutoff for t_d; null when off.

x.description: Covariates in the a- and b-path regressions.

row.description: Which med2s quantity a row is.

adjustment.description: placebo (the estimator), unadjusted (within b-path without the placebo correction), levels (comparison only), or none (total, a).

n_valid.description: Bootstrap replicates that produced the quantity.

naive_se.description: Analytic SE, where one exists (only the total).

signal.description: Identification of the adjusted b-path: treatment must add within-unit mediator variance, d = v1 - v0 > 0. The flag labels an estimate as not identified; it never drops it.

se.description: Cluster-robust analytic SE of d (ignores first-stage error).

flag.description: Low signal: report the mediator as not identified.

boot_flag.description: Bootstrap signal flag (read below about 100 clusters).

se_ratio.description: Analytic over bootstrap SE of d.

moments.description: Within-unit covariances and variances of (uY, uM) on treated (1) and placebo (0) rows.

composition.description: Placebo vs treated rows: adoption index and pre-periods.

a_levels.description: Levels a-path contrast a_raw = a + composition.

diagnostics.description: med2s_diag, run with the same cluster(), anticipation() and covariates.

placebo_grid.description: Adjusted b-path across placebo windows: a matrix structure with columns gap k N b_pl b_pl_se signal t_d b_adj nie adopt_idx npre.

trend_d1.description: Unit-specific linear trends in the untreated first-stage residuals (the gate is M).

reference.description: F (one unit per cluster) or cluster-robust t(G - 1).

slope.description: beta: slope of units' Y trends on their M trends.

x-tools.med2s_diag: r(d1_m_share), r(d1_y_share), r(d1_m_f)/r(d1_m_t), r(d1_y_f)/r(d1_y_t), r(d1_m_p), r(d1_y_p), r(d1_ref), r(d1_G), r(d1_corr), r(d1_slope), r(d1_nunits), r(d1_flag)

trend_d4.description: Event-time profiles of the a-path and the direct effect (descriptive).

x-tools.med2s_diag: r(d4_ne), r(d4_a_slope), r(d4_nde_slope), r(d4_a_growth), r(d4_nde_growth), r(d4_a_mean), r(d4_nde_mean)
r(cl_G), r(cl_G_treated), r(cl_units), r(cl_G_eff), r(cl_hhi), r(cl_nested)

sensitivity.description: med2s_sens from the saved draws: treatment-induced M-Y confounding.

pi.description: Share of the measured mediator response that does not transmit (0 = conservative).

breakdown_share.description: Confounding share at which the NIE interval first includes zero; null when the mediator is flagged and not forced.

grid.description: NIE and NDE with intervals across shares: a matrix structure.

draws.description: Attachment id of the med2s_ci draws file (saving()).
